description.value: Park Motel is a freshly renovated motel in Hope, BC, offering rooms and suites ranging from standard singles to family suites sleeping up to six guests. Situated minutes from downtown Hope and close to Coquihalla Canyon Provincial Park, it serves as a convenient base for exploring the Fraser Canyon area. The property is pet-friendly and non-smoking, with complimentary on-site parking including accessible spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active (copyright 2025, freshly renovated property) confirming Park Motel is open in Hope, BC. Wi-Fi is positively confirmed by the website ('Free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the property'), corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan tag. No mention of bike storage, laundry, tools, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; the OSM address uses '4th Street' while the website consistently says '4th Ave', flagged as a discrepancy.
concerns: Address street type mismatch: OSM has '4th Street' but website consistently shows '4th Ave' — website value used in address field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel in Hope, BC with an active website and confirmed contact details. Useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Fraser Canyon route.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website notes complimentary breakfast is included with all rooms, but does not specify early availability or packed/to-go options, so 'Early or packed breakfast' remains null.
